title: MiCA Register Presence Check
description: Answers one question about a pasted extract of an ESMA MiCA public register: was a named entity present in that snapshot on the date the reader captured it? The reader names the register type (the register of crypto-asset white papers, or the register of authorised crypto-asset service providers), supplies the entity identifier, supplies the capture date, and pastes the extract. The kernel digests the pasted bytes exactly as pasted into register_snapshot_digest, parses the extract with RFC 4180 quoting, searches either every cell or one caller-named column, and emits a single fixed verdict sentence: as of the retrieval date, the entity was or was not present in the named register snapshot with that digest. HARD FENCE: the extract, the entity identifier, the register type and the retrieval date are every one of them a caller input. This node performs no lookup of any kind (zero-egress), ships no bundled copy of either register, adds no scheduled refresh, and has no clock at all, so retrieval_date dates the reader's capture rather than the run. match_found is a tristate: null means the search did not run, and it is never collapsed into a false. Oversized extracts are refused with a named flag rather than truncated, since a digest over bytes the reader never saw would be worse than no reading. Presence is a dated fact about a snapshot, never authorisation, never a current status, never a claim the register itself is complete or current, and never legal advice.

register_type.description: Required. Either 'white_paper' (register of crypto-asset white papers) or 'casp' (register of authorised crypto-asset service providers). No default is inferred: the verdict sentence names the register in words.

entity_identifier.description: Required. LEI or register ID, compared as a literal string (trimmed) against the extract's own cells. No name resolution and no directory is held.

register_extract.description: Required. The register extract as pasted, verbatim. Digested exactly as supplied into register_snapshot_digest. Refused rather than truncated above 262144 characters or 5000 parsed rows.

retrieval_date.description: Required. ISO YYYY-MM-DD date on which the READER captured the extract. Never read from a clock: the kernel contains no Date object in any form.

register_source_ref.description: Optional free text recording where the extract came from. Echoed into the receipt, never checked.

delimiter.description: Optional single-character field delimiter. Defaults to a comma. Quoted fields may contain the delimiter, line breaks and doubled quotes.

header_row.description: Optional. Defaults to true: the first non-blank parsed line is read as a header and excluded from the searched rows.

match_column.description: Optional header name or 0-based column index to restrict the comparison to. Null compares every cell. A name that does not appear in the header raises judgment_required rather than widening back to an any-cell search.

case_sensitive.description: Optional. Defaults to true. When false, both the identifier and each cell are lowercased before comparison.

mcp_tool_definition.name: check_mica_register_presence
mcp_tool_definition.description: Reports whether a named entity was present in a pasted ESMA MiCA register extract as of a caller-supplied retrieval date, pinned by a SHA-256 digest of the pasted bytes. Never an authorisation or current-status claim.
